page.overview:
Who is Moai?

Moai is a large man with light colored hair tied in a ponytail. He wears a tattered light color tank top, a beaded neckless, a dotted bandana, a beaded belt and low hanging pants.

In the Digitally Colored Manga, Moai was given a color scheme matching Compo's anime appearance.

Not much is known about Moai's personality yet, but he is loyal to his captain and worries about his well-being.

Moai was one of the Kid Pirates witnessing her captain fight Big Mom on Onigashima's Live Floor. When Kid's railgun attack proved to be not enough to finish off Big Mom at first, he was one of the members that tried to convince their captain to retreat, however, he was promptly ignored by him.
